threshold: Use the already selected checkpoint's final validation-calibrated threshold; never calibrate on this suite.
scope: All210 distinct four-number roots from1..10; exhaustive fitting, not unseen-root generalization. Every required completion/reachability group and disjoint-optimal-action goal-switch subset passes separately. New local2/3-number held goals are frozen before fresh training; identical numerical states may occur across questions. No test checkpoint selection, pruning or search. Stronger intermediate-goal acceptance additionally requires both frozen4-to2 (two-step) subsets to pass separately; one-step suffixes cannot compensate. Old mixed-group acceptance is retained as historical evidence.
